summary_en: This study tests belinostat, given with cisplatin and etoposide, in people with high-grade neuroendocrine carcinoma, with the belinostat dose chosen by UGT1A1 gene status. All three drugs are given by intravenous infusion in 21-day cycles; belinostat is given as a 48-hour continuous infusion on days 1 to 3, and after cycle 6 belinostat may continue alone for up to 5 years. The title names belinostat pharmacokinetics and toxicity as the focus, and a main outcome is not stated.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa belinostat, administrado junto con cisplatino y etopósido, en personas con carcinoma neuroendocrino de alto grado, con la dosis de belinostat elegida según el estado del gen UGT1A1. Los tres medicamentos se administran por infusión intravenosa en ciclos de 21 días; el belinostat se administra como infusión continua de 48 horas los días 1 a 3, y después del ciclo 6 el belinostat puede continuar solo por hasta 5 años. El título indica que el enfoque son la farmacocinética y la toxicidad del belinostat, y no se indica un resultado principal.
who_for: Adults aged 18 or older with extrapulmonary high-grade neuroendocrine neoplasm.
No known standard therapy that can extend life expectancy for the disease.
Measurable or non-measurable disease per RECIST 1.1.
ECOG performance status 2 or lower at screening.
Blood counts, liver and kidney function within limits set in the record.
not_for: Another histone deacetylase inhibitor taken within 2 weeks before enrollment.
Investigational drug, chemotherapy, immunotherapy or radiotherapy within 14 days before first dose.
New York Heart Association class III or IV heart disease, or QTc above 450 msec.
Pregnancy, or allergy to compounds similar to study drugs.
